plugins.//: App-to-app Facebook Page connect (no web OAuth, no OTP). appID + clientToken come from the Meta App Dashboard (Settings → Basic for the ID, Settings → Advanced → Client token). scheme MUST be fb<appID>. Requires an EAS/dev build — the SDK is a native module (not in Expo Go). See docs/social-connect-native.md. isAutoInitEnabled is false on purpose: the SDK must NOT init in Application.onCreate (a bad/placeholder appID there crashes app launch before the splash). src/lib/facebook-auth.ts calls Settings.initializeSDK() lazily, only when the retailer taps Connect Facebook.
